subject: Literature
title: Romeo and Juliet as Tragic Template
description: A short lesson to help you apply Romeo and Juliet as Tragic Template.

hook.text: Two teenagers fall in love, and within five days everyone around them is dead. It was meant as a warning.

buildup.text: Romeo and Juliet dramatized how family hatred and impulsive passion can lead to irreversible destruction.

discovery.text: Shakespeare borrowed the plot from an Italian poem but added the urgency, wit, and tragic speed himself.

twist.text: Modern audiences see it as a love story, but Shakespeare likely intended it as a cautionary tale about recklessness.

climax.text: The play created the star-crossed lovers archetype that defines romance in literature, film, and music.

punchline.text: A warning about reckless love became its greatest anthem.

quiz.question: How did Shakespeare likely intend Romeo and Juliet?
options: As a celebration of true love conquering all
As a cautionary tale about recklessness and family hatred
As a comedy with a tragic twist ending
